Eva L.: Quick heads up — saw an unexpected kernel fallback on an AMD node during a seq=512 burst. runtime logs show `no_optimized_kernel` for attention_fwd and p50 jumped ~20%. Anyone seen this? :eyes:

Mike H.: Saw the same in last night's perf scan on eu-west. Short log:
```
2026-03-16T03:12:11Z ERROR kernel_loader: no_optimized_kernel: attention_fwd v2
fallback -> generic_attention
```

Charlie R.: My hunch is an op-signature mismatch from the upstream attention refactor (split conv/attn kernels). ROCm build is missing a symbol for the v2 kernel. Try `ldd` on the module and grep the symbol table, and check the kernel manifest at /opt/rocm/kernels.json.

perf-bot: perf/regression detected: model=gpt-j seq=512 p50 latency +18% (canary vs baseline) — trace: https://perftools/trace/1938765432

Samir P.: We should add a conditional routing rule: if kernel_probe fails for attention_fwd on AMD, route to a seq-aware CPU path or a smaller-block GPU kernel instead of falling back to the generic path. Small steady overhead but avoids the big spike.

Eva L.: Also noticed KV cache warmup shows memcpy spikes when we fallback — likely different KV layout triggers an extra copy. Tracy snippet:
```
memcpy 0.12ms -> 2.8ms after fallback
kv_cache_hits drops ~90% for first 10 steps
```

Mike H.: Proposed runtime changes:
- add a probe at model load to validate kernel signatures against the model opset
- expose metric `kernel_probe_failure{model,device}` to alert/rollbacks
- routing policy: prefer compatible kernel variant, else canary to cpu-path with graceful degradation
I'll sketch a PR tonight.

Charlie R.: I'll start a small patch to kernel-mapper to include signature-compat checks and a probe cache with TTL. We'll canary to staging only.

Eva L.: Repro steps I used: `RUNTIME_DEBUG=1 ./bin/runtime --model gpt-j --seq 512 --batch 1` and check /tmp/kernel-probe.log. Uploaded trace: https://perftools/trace/1938765432

Samir P.: Thanks — I'll schedule a quick sync with eng-runtime tomorrow to decide thresholds and rollout plan. :calendar:

Mike H.: tagging @charlie and @eva for the PR review. :thumbsup:
